figurative_meaning_en: Out of one's mind or completely senseless due to drunkenness
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটা পান করেছে যে বেহেড মাতালের মতো হাঁটছে।
পার্টিতে বেহেড মাতাল হয়ে সবাইকে হাসিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He drank so much that he was walking like a headless drunk.
He got completely senseless at the party and made everyone laugh.
note: This idiom vividly describes extreme intoxication, emphasizing loss of control as if one has no head to think with.
